notas: Crop options and filters: official rotation table (opciones_b3.json). Source: Documento maestro del proyecto, §5.2 (v3.1, 29-oct-2026), «Rotaciones candidatas» y «Filtros duros»; expediente de datos 27, §2.3 (INIFAP, Agenda Técnica Agrícola de Chihuahua 2017). Las fuentes primarias van en cada opción y en cada filtro
Filters are never decided with an invented threshold: «needs_local_check» means the filter needs local data the tool does not have, or its source sets no threshold.

Drip scenario: the drip and surface field efficiencies are indicative values from the cited source, not measured in this district ([V] indicative, not local). Source: FAO, Irrigation Water Management Training Manual No. 4, «Irrigation Scheduling» (Brouwer, Prins y Heibloem, 1989), Anexo I, Tabla 8 «Indicative values of the field application efficiency (ea)»: riego superficial 60 %, aspersión 75 %, goteo 90 %. https://www.fao.org/3/t7202e/t7202e08.htm, leído el 14-nov-2026. Valor indicativo general, no medido en el DR-005

Drip scenario, how kit X3.1 was read (it does not say how to go from the gravity water depth to drip): field delivery with drip is the larger of crop ET ÷ ea_goteo and current delivery × ea_superficial_referencia ÷ ea_goteo (the more conservative reading). With the consumption cap, ET and area stay the same. Without it, dam water stays the same, the freed water irrigates more area of the same crop and ET rises in that proportion; the aquifer return keeps the same coefficient as an upper bound. Options that take no water have no drip scenario.
Money row: no verified margin data.
Más de la mitad de las parcelas quedan abstenidas (781 de 1239): el kit (A4.2) pide notificarlo

helada_siembra.texto_en: Chile planted from February is exposed to late frost. The card shows the chance of frost after the planting date; it does not decide.

chile_sin_solanaceas.texto_en: Do not plant chile after chile. After a Phytophthora capsici outbreak, keep at least 5 years without host crops. The satellite memory shows summer crops but not which crop, so this needs a local check.
chile_sin_solanaceas.fuente: Documento maestro del proyecto, §5.2 (v3.1, 29-oct-2026), filtro 3: Silva-Rojas et al. 2009 (Delicias y Camargo; se adopta el criterio más estricto); INIFAP indica 4 años

soca_algodon.texto_en: Cotton stalks must be shredded within 10 days after harvest and uprooted before November 30 (official plant-health rule NOM-026).
soca_algodon.fuente: Documento maestro del proyecto, §5.2 (v3.1, 29-oct-2026), filtro 4; INIFAP, Agenda Técnica Agrícola de Chihuahua 2017 (NOM-026)

alfalfa_no_en_anio_seco.texto_en: Alfalfa should not be established in a dry year: it needs about 40 cm of irrigation just to establish.

alfalfa_tras_alfalfa.texto_en: Leave at least 12 months between one alfalfa stand and the next (autotoxicity).

filtros.fuente: Documento maestro del proyecto, §5.2 (v3.1, 29-oct-2026), filtro 1 (fechas de siembra INIFAP por cultivo)

filtros.motivo: Alfalfa should not be established in a dry year: it needs about 40 cm of irrigation just to establish.

filtros.motivo: Leave at least 12 months between one alfalfa stand and the next (autotoxicity).
filtros.fuente: Documento maestro del proyecto, §5.2 (v3.1, 29-oct-2026), filtro 6. Fundación Produce Chihuahua indica un mínimo de 6–7 meses (fuente secundaria); se adopta el más estricto

filtros.motivo: Salt tolerance differs by crop (FAO thresholds for soil salinity). There is no measured soil salinity for this field, so this needs a local check.
filtros.fuente: Documento maestro del proyecto, §5.2 (v3.1, 29-oct-2026), filtro 7: FAO-29, Tabla 4 (umbral de ECe del extracto de saturación del suelo, dS/m, y pérdida por cada dS/m de más); valores de S2 §3 que el maestro declara vigentes. Algodón, trigo y cebada: lista del mismo filtro

filtros.motivo: If atrazine was used on the previous maize or sorghum, labels ask to wait 5–10 months depending on the next crop and not to sow alfalfa. Check the label of the exact product.
